title: Hypixel Hit
description: A Spigot/Paper plugin that mimics Hypixel-style hit mechanics for your server.
body:
# **Hypixel Hit**

A 1.8x plugin that changes the server's default combat hit to the Hypixel's ranked bedwars hit combo.

## **Combo Mechanics**
HypixelHit specifically scales up your combat flow by making hits faster than the default Minecraft configurations allowed, adaptively change sprint hit for a clean, smooth zest-tap combo. 

## **Features**
* Fasten Hit.
* Combo Damage.
* Toggleable CPS Cap.
* Toggleable Air Sprint Hit.
* Movement Delay (Simulate Hypixel's lag for easier combo holding).
* Toggleable Consistant KB

## **Warning**
* This plugin does not accurately mimic the Hypixel's knockback, hit trading may be harder.
* This plugin requires ProtocolLib to function properly.
* Please download and install the appropriate 1.8.x build of ProtocolLib from its official resource page on SpigotMC (https://spigotmc.org) before starting your server with this plugin.
